policy: Budgets are release targets, not claims. Measure on representative critical routes and record evidence at the exact candidate SHA.
runtimeRules: No devotional audio or video payload may autoplay or load into the initial critical path unless explicitly required for the current route.
Below-the-fold imagery must use responsive sizing and lazy loading where it does not harm LCP.
Hero/LCP media must use an appropriate modern format, explicit dimensions and responsive sources.
Non-critical animation must not block first interaction and must respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Tamil rendering quality must not be degraded to meet a font budget; prefer system/native coverage or carefully subsetted rights-safe webfonts.
Large temple/gallery collections must use pagination, virtualization or incremental loading rather than unbounded first-load payloads.
Search indexes and governed data packs should be split/lazy-loaded when technically appropriate.
Performance evidence must include at least one representative mobile constrained-network run, not desktop-only results.
